schema.doc: The ONE shared scenario source for the Cosmo E2E disposable Foundation harness. One row per case. See work/in_progress/pentacle__cosmo_e2e_foundation_harness_2026_10/spec.md.
fields: maestro_input (OWNED BY COSMO LEAD; filled at handoff)
fixture (optional; media rows only: {key,path,sha256} under tests/cosmo_e2e/fixtures/)
setup (manifest-owned deterministic pre-actions run before action)
verify (expected outcome as exact observable oracle)

cases.verify: 1 stored user message + 1 published reply; send.receipt.get returns committed receipt; broadcast carries reply text

cases.setup: one user input admitted (route resolved, first dispatch pending)
cases.action: backend assistant.publish; first dispatch gated to fail then succeed
cases.verify: messages==1 unchanged across retry; receipts==1; replay publish returns duplicate==True; exactly-once delivery

cases.setup: one durably-admitted input (ack not yet delivered)
cases.action: client drops; reconnects on a new connection; re-sends same input_identity/request_id
cases.verify: admit idempotent -> no 2nd route, messages unchanged; send.receipt.get reconciles the existing receipt on the new connection

cases.action: upload_blob_init/chunk (REAL bytes) -> assistant.publish w/ attachment; fetch_blob
cases.verify: uploaded sha == read_verified sha == fixture.sha256; downloaded bytes == fixture bytes
blob sha == fixture.sha256; transcriber returns stub transcript; real _urllib_post never called; sha-cache idempotent

cases.action: transcribe_blob where stub poster fails once (503) then succeeds; same request_id
cases.verify: first call 503->error; retry same request_id succeeds; request-id rebinding to a different blob -> bad_request

cases.setup: N prior committed turns (seed via N x send+assistant.publish)
cases.verify: snapshot/history returns exactly the N committed messages in order; counts match store rows

cases.action: drive a turn so composite pending_count>0, then publish
cases.verify: snapshot working==true while in flight (pending_count>0); working==false after assistant.publish

cases.setup: authenticated synthetic token; empty events collection
cases.verify: after add: event present in GET /events?from=&to= with server-owned id; after delete: absent

cases.setup: seed list L with TWO items via POST /lists/{L}/items then PATCH /lists/items/{id}/done at clock T0: I_undo and I_expire
cases.action: (a) PATCH /lists/items/{I_undo}/undone within window; (b) advance clock to T0+WINDOW+eps; (c) PATCH /lists/items/{I_expire}/undone
cases.verify: (a) I_undo restored (done_at NULL), present in GET /lists/{L}/items; (b) I_expire expired; (c) undo I_expire -> HTTP 410 'item expired'
